title: Reading with Purpose — Phonics and Comprehension Quiz
description: Test your phonics and reading comprehension skills!

questions.question: Which letters are vowels?
questions.explanation: The five vowels are A, E, I, O, and U. Every word has at least one vowel.

questions.question: What does the silent 'e' do in a word like 'hope'?
options: It makes the vowel say its name
questions.explanation: The silent 'e' at the end makes the vowel say its long sound (its name). 'Hop' becomes 'hope.'

questions.question: What is the short vowel sound in the word 'cat'?
questions.explanation: The word 'cat' has the short A sound, which says 'ah.'

questions.question: Which word begins with a consonant blend?
questions.explanation: 'Bless' begins with the consonant blend 'bl,' where two consonant sounds blend together.

questions.question: What should you do to understand a story you are reading?
options: Ask who, what, and where questions
questions.explanation: Asking who, what, and where questions helps us understand and remember what we read.

questions.question: What does a question mark (?) at the end of a sentence mean?
questions.explanation: A question mark means someone is asking a question and your voice should go up at the end.

questions.question: Which of these is a sight word?
questions.explanation: 'The' is one of the most common sight words. It appears in almost every sentence we read.

questions.question: In the story of David and the lion, what did David do?
options: He trusted God and saved his sheep
questions.explanation: David was brave, trusted God, and fought the lion to save his father's sheep.
